line_items.reasoning: Q3 revenue of $13.7B came in above the high end of the guided range of $12.6B–$13.6B, marking the fourth consecutive quarter of revenue above guidance.
Non-GAAP gross margin of 40% was 4 percentage points above the guided ~36%, driven by higher revenue, favorable mix, and lower inventory reserves.
Q3 non-GAAP EPS of $0.23 significantly exceeded the guided breakeven, driven by stronger revenue, margins, and cost discipline.

No specific Q3 CapEx update was reported that contradicts the prior guidance of ~$18B gross / $8B–$11B net for 2025; the secured ~$20B in cash supports the funding framework but does not indicate a CapEx deviation.
No explicit update contradicting the reaffirmed 2025 OpEx target of $17B or the 75,000 headcount goal was reported, suggesting execution remains on track with prior guidance.
